intentEvidence: engineered for researchers, technical authors, and knowledge workers in Obsidian desktop environments.
problem: Standard LLM interactions often break complex Markdown syntax (WikiLinks, LaTeX, callouts) and lack context-aware translation or professional proofreading capabilities within Obsidian.
summary: AI-powered proofreading and translation tool that uses syntax masking to protect Markdown structure while leveraging LLMs for context-aware text refinement.
